summary: Compact selection card, clear-selection, relative rotation with collision cursor, 15 degree catalog keyboard step, visible lock state, copy/delete row and corrected sofa wood leg masks. Lighting experiments reverted.

impactAnalysis.notes: Reviewed source/dependency sweep. Stand owns global catalog defaults and project geometry. No tenant/permission/entitlement/usage/background job changes; existing auth and organization filtering stay intact. Saved project payload retains 15 degree angles. Migration snapshots populated catalog steps for rollback, preserves NULL leaves and default orientation, and does not edit customer projects. BOM quantities unchanged. Existing item-specific Shift+R lookup and group keyboard behavior remain; card buttons use the shared speculative rotation cursor across invalid placements. No new lights, materials only separate sofa upholstery and wood by asset-space geometry. Browser tests use seeded local standalone runtime; production-shaped live CRM acceptance remains separate. Existing findings are reviewed context, not closed by this UI/catalog package.

e2e.reason: Real browser selection/clear, lock, collision progression, saved/reopened 15 degree geometry, copying and actual compressed sofa materials.

risk.notes: Shared placement angle normalization expands to 15 degree increments. Regression tests retain collision, stand bounds, copy semantics, group controls and exact persistence assertions. Physical mobile device and live acceptance not inferred from standalone E2E.

migration.notes: 0087_rotation_step_15 changes populated catalog rotation steps to 15, backs up previous values for downgrade, and preserves NULL leaves/default orientation/customer project geometry.

rollback: Downgrade 0087 restores previous catalog steps where still 15 and preserves later admin edits. Revert this editor package together with its migration; retain unrelated merged image-upload safety fixes and existing auth.
